scripts.build: npm run db:chores:generate && tsc && npm run copy-schema && node scripts/copy-spa-to-dist.mjs
scripts.db:chores:migrate: node scripts/with-chores-db-url.mjs npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:chores:seed: npm run db:chores:migrate && node scripts/with-chores-db-url.mjs npx tsx prisma/seed-chores.ts
scripts.db:chores:reset: node scripts/with-chores-db-url.mjs npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.test: node --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --import tsx --experimental-test-module-mocks --test src/routes/authz.test.ts src/db/schemaAuthorization.test.ts src/services/scoring.test.ts src/services/taskGenerator.test.ts src/services/allowance.test.ts src/services/choreImportParse.test.ts src/bitcoinWalletConfig.test.ts src/services/bitcoinWalletDerivation.test.ts src/services/workTimer.test.ts src/routes/workTimer.test.ts src/corsOrigins.test.ts src/securityMiddleware.smoke.test.ts src/startupSecurityGate.test.ts src/config.smoke.test.ts src/middleware/rateLimit.test.ts src/routes/taskPoints.test.ts src/db/taskLedger.test.ts src/routes/childChoreLink.test.ts src/db/choresPostgres.test.ts src/db/productionStartupReadOnly.test.ts src/mcp/mcp.test.ts
